description: This source file contains implementations related to pack geometry management within a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for initializing, sorting, splitting, selecting, removing redundant packs, and releasing pack geometry data structures.

methods.name: uint32_t pack_geometry_weight(struct packed_git * p)
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a pack based on its index. Opens the index if necessary.

methods.name: int pack_geometry_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
methods.description: Comparison function for packs based on their weight, used for sorting.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_init(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct existing_packs * existing,const struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Initializes pack geometry by collecting relevant packs based on criteria such as localness, keep status, and cruft status.

methods.name: uint32_t compute_pack_geometry_split(struct packed_git ** pack,size_t pack_nr,int split_factor)
methods.description: Computes the index at which to split packs in a geometric progression for optimization.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Performs the split computation for the current pack geometry based on the split factor.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Returns the preferred pack for operations, typically the largest pack above the split line that's local.

methods.name: void remove_redundant_packs(struct packed_git ** pack,uint32_t pack_nr,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files that are not needed based on existing pack list and status flags.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs within the given pack geometry structure.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Frees allocated memory within the pack geometry structure.
